# Sehatra - Healthcare Operations & Documentation Digital Toolkits

> Sehatra is an independent provider of editable administrative documentation for clinics, polyclinics, hospitals, and labs in Pakistan. The toolkits are designed around commonly referenced Punjab Healthcare Commission (PHC) Minimum Service Delivery Standards (MSDS) and similar provincial requirements. Sehatra is not endorsed, authorized, or affiliated with PHC, SHCC, KP-HCC, IHRA, or any other regulator.

## Overview
- **Brand Name:** Sehatra
- **Website:** https://zeshanhaider1.github.io/sehatra/
- **Primary Product Line:** Healthcare Operations Toolkit (administrative documentation and editable templates)
- **Primary Market:** Pakistan (Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Islamabad)
- **Reference Standards:** PHC Category-II and Category-III MSDS, SHCC, KP-HCC, IHRA (facilities should verify current requirements with their regulator)
- **File Formats:** Editable Microsoft Word (.docx) and Excel (.xlsx); some PDFs
- **Delivery:** Google Drive link + WhatsApp ZIP; delivery target is within 60 minutes after payment confirmation
- **Payment Rails:** Raast, Easypaisa, JazzCash, online bank transfer (UBL)
- **WhatsApp Support:** +92 304 2917388

---

## Digital Products & Pricing (PKR)

### 1. PHC Category-III Clinic Compliance Starter Kit
- **Price:** PKR 4,999
- **Target Audience:** General Practitioners (GPs), single-doctor OPD clinics, polyclinics, dental practices
- **Key Deliverables:**
  - Category-III clinic operations SOP manual covering 18 standards (.docx)
  - 47-point MSDS self-audit checklist (.docx)
  - Standards and evidence tracker (.docx)
  - Weekly hygiene, sterilization, and OPD scorecard (.docx)
  - Daily biomedical waste disposal register (.docx)
  - Bilingual patient rights and responsibilities charter (.pdf)
- **Product Page:** https://zeshanhaider1.github.io/sehatra/phc-category-iii-clinic-kit.html

### 2. Clinic Infection Control & Biomedical Waste Bundle
- **Price:** PKR 2,999
- **Target Audience:** Labs, dental clinics, daycare surgery centers, OPD clinics
- **Key Deliverables:**
  - Daily biomedical waste logbook with color-coded bag tracking (.docx)
  - CSSD autoclave sterilization logbook (.docx)
  - CSSD equipment breakdown and recall register (.docx)
  - Needle-stick injury (NSI) logbook and incident record (.docx)
  - Weekly disinfection and sanitation sheet (.docx)
  - Sterilization protocol poster (.pdf)
- **Product Page:** https://zeshanhaider1.github.io/sehatra/infection-control-biomedical-waste-bundle.html

### 3. Hospital Staff Complete HR Dossiers & Job Descriptions Pack
- **Price:** PKR 4,999
- **Target Audience:** 5-50 bed hospitals, maternity homes, surgical daycare centers
- **Key Deliverables:**
  - Staff master file template: appointment letter, health form, 14-point checklist (.docx)
  - 16-cadre clinical and administrative job descriptions with sign-off sheets (.docx)
  - Staff orientation manual: safety, patient privacy, code of conduct (.docx)
  - Performance appraisal pack and master appraisal register (.docx)
  - Urdu job descriptions for janitorial and security staff (.docx)
  - Staff credentialing and verification tracker (.docx)
- **Product Page:** https://zeshanhaider1.github.io/sehatra/hospital-hr-dossiers.html

### 4. Hospital Statutory Audit & Committees Toolkit (CQI, OTMC, HICC)
- **Price:** PKR 6,999
- **Target Audience:** Secondary hospitals, surgical centers, healthcare facility managers
- **Key Deliverables:**
  - CQI 5-document sequence: notification, attendance, monitoring tool, report, minutes (.docx)
  - 6 clinical KPI domains: adverse drug events, critical lab notifications, surgical audits (.docx)
  - Operation Theatre Management Committee (OTMC) pack (.docx)
  - Hospital Infection Control Committee (HICC) terms of reference and surveillance records (.docx)
  - Medical record review suite: case sampling sheet and 10% IPD clinical audit (.docx)
- **Product Page:** https://zeshanhaider1.github.io/sehatra/hospital-cqi-committees.html

### 5. All-in-One Healthcare Operations & Hospital Accreditation Vault
- **Price:** PKR 11,999 (regular price PKR 19,996; saving PKR 7,997, approximately 40%)
- **Target Audience:** Hospital management, medical superintendents, clinic owners
- **Includes:** All 4 toolkits above, plus a quick-start organization guide and 30 days of WhatsApp query support

## Ordering and Delivery
1. Visit https://zeshanhaider1.github.io/sehatra/
2. Select a toolkit and submit the order form or message on WhatsApp (+92 304 2917388)
3. Pay via Raast ID `0304-2917388`, Easypaisa `0304-2917388`, or UBL IBAN `PK78UNIL0009000292001123`
4. Share the transaction screenshot on WhatsApp
5. Receive the Google Drive access link and ZIP file; delivery target is within 60 minutes after payment confirmation

- **Support:** 7 days of format adjustments and template guidance
- **Confidentiality:** Order details are used for fulfillment and support

---

## Important Scope Note
Sehatra provides administrative and operational documentation, not medical advice, legal advice, or regulatory approval. Inspection outcomes depend on each facility's implementation, records, staff practices, and the regulator's review. Facilities should check current requirements directly with their provincial healthcare commission.
